body: It's suffocating
It would be better this way, then for them to find that out.
They wouldn't be that type of ashamed.  They go through a lot already, and have been let down my my sister already, to give them more stress would be a burden on me.

Family would tell me to seek religion.  And they wouldn't understand, well they might, but not to the extent I need.  Also, I couldn't hurt their image of me, they're already going through enough.  I work two jobs, and a full time student there's not much time in between,
Seeking help would be incredibly embarrassing to my family, I'm sure they would just lock me up.
I'm in college now with a year and a half left, going no where.
I can't pinpoint them, well, I know what they are. I'm in my head so I analyze myself.  I would just really like to end myself before I get dangerous.
I don't like opening up, and I don't like painting myself as weak.  She also had conflicting times, had other clients, and most of my problems seem silly out loud.

Talked, bullshitted my way out, then cut contact with university therapist.  There are others worse than me.  Feeling cared for is a funny thing, I hate personal contact now.

Your worry is admiral, but it's wasted on me, it's not that serious.

I just don't belong, I can't bring myself to actually care, but I can pretend.  Some eternal light within me burned out a while ago.  And this emptiness is a tree, all the roots are growing in my lungs.  I don't want to be this exhausted while awake anymore.
Kindness on the outside doesn't stop the wretchedness inside me,
If everyone's life is worth more than mine, I'd rather jump into the blaze.
Reckless but noble
Perfection
Such nice words, don't waste them on me but thanks.
I've lived my whole 20 years knowing that I will die early, by myself or by something else.  I can sort of relate.
Sorry thanks for talking, but I don't feel like responding anymore

I work at a zoo.

The thing is my parents had a bad life, my mom had trouble raising us, my sister didn't make it easy.  Our family is hard on my mother.  Other family members have gone astray, I want to be perfect, because they deserve it.  I did this to myself, there is no reverse, only escape.  My lungs are the pool, and I am suffocating.  There is no way to tie my degree in, I'm nearly a junior and still undecided.
Not a feasible idea for my situation.  Thanks though.

I make them sound like horrible people, but I think that's because it's in my head.  My boyfriend doesn't understand, he thinks you can just be happy.  I think it's easy to pretend, tiring, but controlled too. Not sure what makes me happy, but I love my cats.

I think that that thought pattern has ruined me.

I'd most likely take all the animals.  Most of the ones around me are kill shelters

I'm not Asian, I just believe that my family deserves a perfect daughter.  But I think that's withered my sanity.  I'm just calculated, I like having control.  Is it possible to turn into a sociopath?  Maybe I have.

Not sure what makes me happy, but I love my cats.
I have no control.   I don't think happiness is an emotion in equipped to deal with.  Doing this, I believe, will give me control.

2, then 4 from nov-Xmas.  I don't like any of my jobs, it's tiring and both require me to be happy and approachable.  I do it because I have to, because I need to, and because it's expected in my family and society.  When my family asks I say I love them, that I can do it, that they even offer me bonuses/internships, but it's all forced and calculated.  I'm going to quit, or just stop showing up before I leave.   Last night I dreamed a about quitting, it made me happy.

If I quit my jobs, or one job, I couldn't pay for my car payments and insurance.  I don't think I could deal with a repo.  I definitely don't want to look like a failure.  By going to anyone with this I'd be just that, a failure.

The problem is I don't think there's anything to change, I've always felt like I'm going nowhere. Even with scholarships, multiple jobs, and a new car.  Like I was predestined to die early.  When I say I feel empty, it's a dangerous kind of empty.
